text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My aim is to claim the first European G1 victory as a Tracen athlete.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer suggests the Prix Maurice de Gheest. It's a 1,300-meter G1 sprint, and I feel a strong sense of affinity with this destined race of mine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It takes place before the Prix Jacques Le Marois, so if I win it, there's a high possibility people will think I did it to steal Taiki's glory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Prix Maurice de Gheest or the Prix Jacques Le Marois… We can decide which one I'll run in after I'm done with the Yasuda Kinen!
